limitations: Structural proposal coverage and valid copied grammar do not establish law fidelity, actor/modality binding or legal correctness.
PCA and AE reconstruction values retain full768 width; no lower-width latent capacity, storage/latency gain or matched conditioner training is measured.
PCA is applied to embeddings of source text; the span decoder still reads the actual source tokens and generates copied-rule IR.
All64 sources are exposed authored examples with component reuse; TRAIN/DEV label the reconstruction split and do not establish an independent historical decoder holdout.
Joint selection is approximate: top16 candidates and beam64 may remove feasible/correct/global-best assignments; survivor margin is uncalibrated.
Presence/modality remain native fixed decisions and may be wrong; no optional facet dropping, greedy fallback or new role-binding policy.
Single-rule copied spans cannot represent general quantified or multi-rule laws; broad family pilot remains separately gated.
No8D/384D matched conditioner decoder and no Leanstral embeddings/generation are executed here.
Selected source/provider entrypoints are not complete binary attestation or an OS sandbox.

resources.scope: Current native model/head capture plus both span selection policies; excludes upstream encoding/vector-bank creation/prior fitting/independent audits.
